page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the single-core performance of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% for single-core stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, the 24 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, positioning the instance in the middle 50% for multi-threaded workloads such as bzip3 decompression, software compilation, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is stable, with cached read speeds of 983.75 GB/sec and uncached write speeds of 53.0 GB/sec, both aligning with average tier performance.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core processing capabilities, this instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded application servers. The lack of local storage and specialized accelerators like GPUs limits its utility for high-performance computing or real-time AI training, but it offers a stable, resource-dense environment for standard enterprise applications. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable performance without the overhead of shared-core resource contention.
